column1: # Custom partition table for ESP32-S3 (v3 board) with 16MB flash (used via PartitionScheme=custom).
# The stock PartitionScheme=default_8MB has a SINGLE app slot
# This layout gives two equal OTA slots so the updater can write the inactive slot
# and roll back if the new image fails to boot.
# NOTE: changing the flash map requires a ONE-TIME USB re-flash of the whole
# image (bootloader + partitions + app). OTA from the previous default_8MB
